name: Sioux City Sunday 2023
information: This competition will be held alongside [Sioux Falls Saturday](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SiouxFallsSaturday2023) on the preceding day. You can compete in one or both of the competitions! We also have two local Facebook groups for our Cubing Area. Feel free to join the [Minnesota Cubing Community](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1798123093777480/) and [Iowa Cubing](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1629559883761917/) for information and announcements on upcoming competitions.
